values.binNote: SettR.MaxHealthDamage is 0.4/0.5/0.6 and reads as target max health in the bin's calc, while the wiki describes it as a percentage of the target's bonus health; there is no separate bonus-health-only variable in the bin, so the wiki's 'bonus health' framing cannot be verified against a matching bin row.

Wiki states the reduced (edge) tier as exactly 25% of the base/AD/health-% values, matching a 0.75 reduction near the stated 'up to 75%'; but CraterEdgeDamageReduction=0.5 in the bin implies a 50% reduction (i.e. 0.5x), disagreeing with the wiki's 0.25x multiplier. No bin calculation directly produces the reduced-tier numbers; the 0.25 multiplier is taken from the wiki's own arithmetic notation.

mechanics.claim: Sett dashes to and suppresses the target, then leaps and slams them, dealing damage to nearby enemies based on the target's bonus health.
mechanics.quote: carries the target enemy champion and dashes through the air with displacement immunity, then slams them into the ground to deal physical damage to nearby enemies based on the target's bonus health

mechanics.claim: Enemies within the epicenter (125 unit radius around landing) take full damage; other enemies hit by the shockwave take reduced damage based on proximity, up to 75% reduction.
mechanics.quote: take {{ccs|{{as|physical damage}}|physical}}, and other enemies hit by the shockwave take {{as|physical damage}} that is reduced by up to 75% based on proximity.

mechanics.claim: All targets hit are slowed by 99% for 1 second (crowd control, does not affect either fight).
mechanics.quote: All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 99% for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: If the target resists the suppression (CC-immune, displacement immune, or spell shield), Sett will not attach them but still deals the shockwave damage.
mechanics.quote: If the target resists the suppression by being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or having a {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Sett''' will not attach them to himself.

mechanics.claim: This ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
